title: Movie Ghast
description: Changes the ghast texture to match that of the Minecraft movie!
body:
Ever wanted the ghast to look like the ghast from A Minecraft Movie? Well then this pack is the pack for you!

This pack updates the ghast texture to look like the ghast from the minecraft movie!

Along with updating the normal texture, i've also updated the shooting texture to match the artstyle!

NOTE: If you see an incompatible pack error, just ignore it. This pack should work on versions 1.21.8-1.21.20.
